t_advice_summary_textbox.text: red and blues seem to give more points, pinks seem to give the least amount of points. rest your wrists and move around some because it gets monotonous.

vb_textbox.text: reds, blues, and purples seem like they give the most points, but sometimes it feels like the pattern changes. try and pay attention to that. stay focused, and take advantage of the breaks when you get them.
